⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
One or more scalar measurements, each with a variance and a unit.

Use this for sensors that report a value together with its uncertainty:
pressure, temperature, illuminance, relative humidity, range, and so on.

In a [`views.TimeSeriesView`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/views/time_series_view) each series is drawn as a line with a translucent
band around it, one standard deviation (the square root of the variance) wide in each direction.
Leave `variances` unset if the uncertainty is unknown.

The current timeline value is used for the time/X-axis, so measurements should not be
static. Number of values per timestamp is expected to be the same over time.

Unlike [`archetypes.Scalars`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/archetypes/scalars), this archetype carries its own styling, so values and style
are logged together.
Changes over time are supported for most but not all styling fields (see respective fields for details).

## Fields
### Required
* `values`: [`Scalar`](../components/scalar.md)

### Recommended
* `variances`: [`Variance`](../components/variance.md)

### Optional
* `units`: [`Unit`](../components/unit.md)
* `colors`: [`Color`](../components/color.md)
* `widths`: [`StrokeWidth`](../components/stroke_width.md)
* `names`: [`Name`](../components/name.md)
* `visible_series`: [`Visible`](../components/visible.md)
* `aggregation_policy`: [`AggregationPolicy`](../components/aggregation_policy.md)
* `interpolation_mode`: [`InterpolationMode`](../components/interpolation_mode.md)


## Can be shown in
* [TimeSeriesView](../views/time_series_view.md)
* [DataframeView](../views/dataframe_view.md)
